content.text: Maximum-size burst with 120,000 equal-rank packets completes in about 2.5 seconds locally; the ordinal-bitset statistics are comfortably within the CPU budget.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
n=120000
obj={'mode':'burst','banks':16,'lanes':8,'limit':2147483648,
     'borders':[0,100000,2147483648],'start_bank':15,
     'packets':[{'id':f'id_{i}','lane':i%8,'rank':(i*104729)%2000000000+100000} for i in range(n)]}
# Keep ranks in range 1 (starting at 100000); all are unique enough for Fenwick stress.
with open('/app/max_unique.json','w') as f:json.dump(obj,f,separators=(',',':'))
steps=[]
for k in range(40000):
    arr=[]
    for j in range(3):
        i=3*k+j
        arr.append({'id':f'p{i}','lane':(i+j)%8,'rank':0})
    # Correct any duplicate lanes while retaining 3 attempts per step.
    lanes=[]; used=set()
    for p in arr:
        l=p['lane']
        while l in used:l=(l+1)%8
        p['lane']=l;used.add(l)
    steps.append({'t':k*3,'serve':True,'arrivals':arr})
stream={'mode':'stream','banks':16,'lanes':8,'limit':1,'borders':[0,1],
        'capacity':20000,'epoch':1,'steps':steps}
with open('/app/max_stream.json','w') as f:json.dump(stream,f,separators=(',',':'))
PY
TIMEFORMAT='unique elapsed=%3R user=%3U sys=%3S'; time python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < /app/max_unique.json > /app/max_unique.out
TIMEFORMAT='stream elapsed=%3R user=%3U sys=%3S'; time python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < /app/max_stream.json > /app/max_stream.out
ls -lh /app/max_unique.json /app/max_unique.out /app/max_stream.json /app/max_stream.out

import json
for name in ['max_unique','max_stream']:
 x=json.load(open('/app/'+name+'.out'))
 if 'ticks' in x:print(name,len(x['departures']),x['ticks'],x['idle'],max(d['rank_error'] for d in x['departures']))
 else:print(name,len(x['events']),x['final']['totals'],x['final']['histogram'],[len(q) for q in x['final']['queues']])
PY
